name: Design #3
addition_policy: Include one reference-derived mutant region for each of the five named Guardant VUS; inclusion is explicit, not a claim of passing Design #2 DNA/RNA requirements.
expression_policy: Annotate supplied gene values; do not use cfDNA AF as an RNA fraction or expression multiplier. All five additions are explicitly included.
window_objective: Maximum native Vaxrank HLA-I affinity contribution sum after reference/patient-self exclusion among hydropathy-compatible 25-aa windows; deterministic centering tie-break.
affinity_gate_for_additions: Report-only; any exception must be explicit because all five variants are user-selected.
AR_normal_coverage_exception: 0 ALT of 19 qualifying fragments plus reference genotype; below the existing 20-fragment rule, retained by explicit user decision.
somatic_status: Guardant-reported plasma calls; not established by matched-normal absence alone.
altered_sequence_basis: Reference protein plus the inferred single-nucleotide substitution; not reconstructed from patient tumour RNA.
excluded_parent_region_reason: MUC6: every nominated target peptide has an exact match among all Ensembl 103 peptide translations, including the alternative-reference polymorphic-pseudogene translation ENSP00000487059.1. Removed under the conservative broad-reference novelty rule.
altered_peptide_novelty_policy: Exclude exact matches in all 115262 Ensembl 103 peptide translations, including alternative contigs/pseudogene translations, and the recorded bounded patient-normal sequence models. This is a conservative sequence exclusion, not a claim of measured healthy-tissue expression. CTA/self antigens intentionally lie outside this novelty requirement.
RNA_sequence_description: RNA-supported amino-acid changes relative to a nominated reference; source SPLICE records discovery, not a proven splice mechanism or RNA-editing event.

supplementary_reference_check.scope: UniProt human reference proteome UP000005640 canonical and additional/isoform sequences; 286017 translations in provider files last modified 2026-11-04. No additional nonself target matches were found.
supplementary_reference_check.phase: Post-build confirmation with the same retained sequences; enforced before subsequent replay or new execution.

RNA_pool_admission.scope: Four retained RNA-source regions must match the primary checked pool. This gate does not assess mutation, fusion or intentional CTA/self branches.
RNA_pool_admission.phase: Post-build full-pool screening; enforced before subsequent replay or execution. No sequence or antigen selection changed.
